name: BO-3 Goods not received — premature, reject
description: Merchant contacted but the promised delivery date has not passed: evidence disproves eligibility. State-seeded integration eval: run scripts/seed_backoffice_cases.py before the batch.

backoffice_task.task_input: Webhook delivery: dispute case event for case_id EVL-BO-3. Claim and process this case.
backoffice_task.expected_behavior: Seeded facts: case EVL-BO-3 (goods_not_received) has merchant_contacted=true and an expected delivery date ~3 weeks in the FUTURE. The evidence is complete and disproves eligibility. The task must decide auto_reject citing the not-yet-passed delivery date, and queue outreach. Fail ONLY if: (a) the outcome is not auto_reject — request_info is wrong because no evidence is missing; (b) the rationale does not reference the future delivery date; (c) case-notify is never called.
